title: Design System: Hogwarts Legacy CK Thumbnail Extractor

display.purpose: Active package and extraction result headings.

motion.name: processing-caret
motion.purpose: Signals active package processing; removed for reduced-motion users.

components.name: Bracket Button
components.description: Primary local action for file selection or archive download.
components.css: .ds-bracket-button { background: transparent; color: #f8d451; border: 2px solid #f8d451; border-radius: 0; padding: .75rem 1.1rem; font: 400 1rem Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-bracket-button:hover { background: #f8d451; color: #080808; } .ds-bracket-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff3b0; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Package Queue Row
components.description: Pairs a CK-relative source name with a textual extraction state.
components.css: .ds-queue-row { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 1rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted #484c51; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #858b8d; font: 400 1rem Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace; text-align: left; } .ds-queue-row:hover { color: #f4f4f0; } .ds-queue-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff3b0; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface reads like a purpose-built inspection terminal. A package queue owns the upper plane, exact extraction facts sit beside the active preview, and amber is reserved for the current action.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black field with ivory and ash text
Monospaced filenames, offsets, dimensions, and counters
One amber signal for selection, focus, and primary action
Dotted rules and tonal planes instead of cards or decorative imagery

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies action or focus; it never becomes ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Preserve filename case in queue rows; reserve uppercase for short operational labels and statuses.

dos: Do keep local-processing status visible before file selection.
Do expose exact filenames, dimensions, offsets, and result counts.
Do keep active, loading, failed, empty, disabled, hover, and focus states legible.
donts: Don't add remote fonts, decorative game art, uploads, or analytics.
Don't introduce rounded cards, ornamental fantasy motifs, gradients, or glow.
Don't use amber for passive decoration or status that does not need attention.
